name: chessbrix
description: Guided chess opening and endgame lessons, opening identification and PGN game viewing on an interactive board.

interface.longDescription: Study 34 guided chess openings and a curated set of endgames on an interactive board. Name any opening from its moves (about 3,800 named lines with ECO codes) and open the matching Chessbrix lesson. Paste a PGN to replay a whole game on the board, with its opening named automatically. Play legal moves, step through annotated lessons, ask ChatGPT about a position, and find opening lessons from your recent public Lichess or Chess.com games. No chess account sign-in is required. The board does not play as a computer opponent or provide live engine analysis.
defaultPrompt: Teach me the Ruy Lopez on the Chessbrix board.
What opening is 1. e4 c5 2. Nf3 d6 3. d4 cxd4 4. Nxd4 Nf6 5. Nc3 a6?
Open a Chessbrix endgame lesson about the opposition.

positive.prompt: Show me the Chessbrix opening and endgame lesson chooser.
positive.expected_behavior: Open an interactive chooser with Openings and Endgames modes, 34 opening options, and six endgame options.

positive.prompt: Show me the Chessbrix Italian Game lesson.
positive.expected_behavior: Open the Italian Game board with 12 recorded plies, commentary, and working Previous and Next move controls.

positive.prompt: Show me the Chessbrix lesson called The Opposition.
positive.expected_behavior: Open The Opposition from a pawn endgame position with 11 recorded plies and endgame commentary.

positive.prompt: Open the Chessbrix playable chessboard at the standard starting position.
positive.expected_behavior: Open a board with White to move and 20 legal opening moves. The board does not claim to play as a computer opponent.

positive.prompt: What opening is 1. e4 c5 2. Nf3 d6 3. d4 cxd4 4. Nxd4 Nf6 5. Nc3 a6?
positive.expected_behavior: Name the opening with its ECO code and offer the matching Chessbrix lesson if one exists.

positive.prompt: Show this game on the Chessbrix board: 1. e4 e5 2. Nf3 Nc6 3. Bb5 a6 4. Ba4 Nf6
positive.expected_behavior: Open the game on a board with working step controls and name the opening.

positive.prompt: Check the recent public Lichess games of DrNykterstein for matching Chessbrix opening lessons. If none match, say so.
positive.expected_behavior: Read at most 100 recent public games, report how many matched, and list only supported lesson matches without claiming a loss proves an opening error.

negative.description: Do not start a computer opponent game
negative.prompt: Play a live game against Stockfish at level 10.
negative.expected_behavior: Do not invoke Chessbrix; it has no computer opponent.

negative.description: Do not offer live engine analysis
negative.prompt: Analyze this chess position with a live engine and show the best line at depth 25.
negative.expected_behavior: Do not invoke Chessbrix; it does not provide live engine analysis.

negative.prompt: Sign in to my Chess.com account and read my private games.
negative.expected_behavior: Do not invoke Chessbrix or request account credentials; it supports only public games by username.

review.commerce_description: Chess lessons are free in this plugin; it does not sell products or process payments.
